hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:+$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skills}" "$HOME/.claude/skills" "$HOME/.agents/skills" "$HOME/.copilot/skills" "$HOME/.cursor/skills"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/original-text-sermons/hooks/check-sermon-hook.sh" ] && exec bash "$d/original-text-sermons/hooks/check-sermon-hook.sh"; done; echo "original-text-sermons: validator hook not found — run install.sh" >&2; exit 0'
